metadata.title: $\rm{PGL}_2$ webs at roots of unity
metadata.abstract: We study webs on surfaces for the $\rm{PGL}_2$ skein theory specialized at roots of unity. We construct the $\rm{PGL}_2$ analogue of Chebyshev polynomials and use them to construct central elements in the skein algebra. We then focus on the cases of the 3-punctured sphere and the closed torus. We compute the Frobenius homomorphism for these two surfaces and show that the $\rm{PGL}_2$ Frobenius homomorphism for the torus is not injective when the quantum parameter $q^2$ is a root of unity of even order $n.$

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 单位根 PGL₂ webs 与 Frobenius
analysis.workSummary: 构造 PGL₂ Chebyshev 类多项式产生 skein 中心元，计算三穿孔球和闭环面的 Frobenius 同态，证明环面在 q² 为偶数阶单位根时同态非单射。
analysis.breakthrough: 展示 PGL₂ 单位根结构与既有 skein 理论的具体差异。
analysis.limitations: 非单射结论针对环面与明确的偶数阶参数。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 辅助制图、将 Asymptote 图转换为 TikZ，以及查找引用的 BibTeX 书目信息；图与引用经作者核验。
